name: Edge Flow for Deformable Meshes
description: Arrange polygon edges along the natural deformation lines of a character so that joints (elbows, knees, knuckles) bend cleanly and avoid pinching.
when_to_use: Any character or creature mesh that will be skinned and animated.
conceptual_steps: Identify primary deformation zones from the rig plan.
Lay loops perpendicular to the bend axis at each joint (3 loops minimum: one above, one at, one below).
Keep quad topology along stretching surfaces; tris are acceptable on rigid plates.
Mirror across symmetry plane only after edge flow validation.
tradeoffs: More loops = better deformation but heavier mesh. Aim for joint loop budget ≤ 5 % of total polycount.
